---
title: "Unrestricted overall survival — Adjusted (hierarchical) fitting"
format: html
---

- Sensitivity analysis: diagnosis random intercept instead of the lung indicator.
- Hazard ratio is conditional on covariates and diagnosis effects.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(here)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "05-unrestricted-hierarchical", "results"
)
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)
datasets <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "completed-datasets.rds"))

stopifnot(length(datasets) == config$imputation$m_supporting)
```

## Fitting

```{r}
#| label: fit-hierarchical-models
#| include: false

for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))

  if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
    fitting_data <- datasets[[index]] |>
      # Zero follow-up is dropped from fitting only.
      filter(survival_time_days_unrestricted > 0)

    stopifnot(!anyNA(fitting_data), nrow(fitting_data) > 0L)

    model <- stan_surv(
      Surv(survival_time_days_unrestricted, status_death_unrestricted) ~
        tx + ecog_binary + stage_binary + mgps + (1 | diagnosis),
      data = fitting_data,
      basehaz = "ms",
      basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
      prior = normal(
        location = rep(0, 5),
        scale = c(0.55, rep(2.5, 4))
      ),
      prior_intercept = normal(0, 20),
      prior_aux = dirichlet(1),
      prior_covariance = decov(),
      chains = 4L,
      cores = 4L,
      iter = 2000L,
      warmup = 1000L,
      adapt_delta = 0.99,
      refresh = 0L,
      seed = 4200L + index
    )

    saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  }
}
```
